I will keep my farm simple and stable this year. I am 70, I have a lot of experience, my education is high, and some family labor is away working off-farm, so I will avoid overly complicated management and focus on crops I know well and can manage reliably with well irrigation. Because my land is only 20 mu and my main system is wheat-maize, I will keep most of the land in the wheat-maize rotation and leave a smaller share for cotton. I will use better seed on all crops, keep fertilizer at a moderate but solid level, irrigate on time rather than excessively, and rely on rotary tillage because it is efficient and practical for my labor situation. I will not chase the highest possible input level; I will aim for steady yield, manageable fieldwork, and lower risk.
